status: Implemented, database migration applied and verified, demo and admin deployed, and native iPhone bundle synchronized
profilePresentation: Short discovery introductions; personal facts and longer marriage narratives are expandable. Preference fit and personality alignment appear separately.

criterionModes.prefer: Observed optional preferences contribute 20% to the directed preference score; existing marriage assessment contributes 80%. Unknown data is omitted and coverage is disclosed.
criterionModes.require: New discovery and requests must satisfy both members' explicit requirements; unknown required values do not pass. Existing accepted conversations retain the established eligibility rules.

preferenceAssessment: The existing 30 self/desired-partner responses cover children, residence and relocation, marriage timing, family input, household finances and responsibilities, lifestyle and communication. Current complete assessments gate the percentage.

personalityAssessment.method: Mean normalized answer similarity on a five-point scale. Both people must complete all 12 questions to show a percentage. Raw answers remain private.
personalityAssessment.provenance: Behavioral concepts adapted from the owned BlindMatch questionnaire. Retired MBTI questions and event-specific percentile calibration were not reused.
personalityAssessment.limits: Neither percentage is a validated marriage-success probability. No trained AI model is enabled or claimed.

research.finding: Publishes height, weight, nationality, education, occupation, family origin and tribe fields.
Describes marital status, family plans, values and communication preferences; recognizes sensitivity of family-origin and tribal information.
Advertises Saudi-context region and tribal/nontribal search and family accounts.
Lists height, future plans, religious practice, profession and interests as filters.
Separates introductions, interests, personality traits and selected icebreakers.

researchScope: Official public documentation, not authenticated competitor onboarding or individual profiles. Field inventory informed this release; it is not a claim of complete competitor feature parity.
privacy: Public optional details are explicitly disclosed at entry and review. Partner criteria and raw personality answers are available only in the owner's private profile. Tribal information is never inferred from names, photos or location; no lineage ranking. Admin reviewers see the newly public details.
